statement: The build needs the Slow Roast Whiz bonus in Equinox so damage scales up over time in tower defense.
The build needs a decently leveled Canoli in the dinner menu.
With the new meal ribbons you can get over 1000% extra points in tower defense.
Optionally bring your Beast Master and use the Stop Right There attack talent to prevent mistakes during high enemy count waves.
Anyone with the Equinox bonus unlocked can use this guide.
Depending on tower levels in construction or the Canoli bonus you may clear more or fewer waves than shown.
After summoning the waves start by placing a Poisonic Elder tower as a temporary tower.
The temporary Poisonic Elder gets you through the first wave or two and lets you place more towers without chasing enemies.
Place a Frozone tower as close to the portal as possible then a Voidinator tower right next to it.
Keep towers tight together because you need all the space you can get.
Place the first Kraken after the Voidinator; delete the first Poisonic Elder to line things up then place a Kraken and quickly replace the Elder in line.
Always summon 10 waves at a time because the slow roast whiz bonus resets each time a new wave spawns.
Keep Kraken eyeballs close together or a trickle of enemies could leak through the contained build.
Summon the first Party Starter on the top row against the portal and use trait A.
Level up Party Starters immediately when placed because they do nothing until a trait is selected.
Level the rest of your towers to level 5 starting with the Poisonic Elder and select trait A.
Voidinator is the next leveling priority after the Elder because its attack speed must go up to cope with more enemies.
Always select trait B on Voidinator since a 10-second cast time lets many monsters slip through.
Start every Kraken with trait B then change to trait A at level 10 plus.
Always select trait A on Frozone towers in this build.
Summon three more Party Starters on the top row with trait A each.
On the bottom row summon one Kraken followed by a Frozone with the same traits as before.
Place four more Krakens all at level 5 with trait B to complete the defensive line.
Summon a Stormcaller on the top row next to the Party Starters and select trait B.
Stormcaller trait B increases crit chance of the primary damage dealing towers.
Stormcaller range increases a lot with each level so it may not reach yet but will later.
Summon two more Party Starters with trait A for more attack speed.
Goal is Kraken attack speed of 0.3 seconds or less when towers are around level 15 to 20.
Level all Party Starters to 15 selecting trait A each time giving 18 traits at this stage.
18 traits isn't enough for 0.3s Krakens so summon one more Party Starter with the same traits.
Summoning a new Party Starter for 48000 points is cheaper than leveling existing towers to 20.
Level Poisonic Elder to 15 with trait B at level 10 and A at level 15 giving ABA.
From then on always trait A so all Krakens have a BA setup at level 15.
Level Frozone towers to 15 always selecting trait A.
Always select trait B on Stormcaller for more crit chance on damage dealing towers.
Summon a last Poisonic Elder as a safety net needed much later if enemies push too far on the bottom row.
Level the safety net Poisonic Elder to 15 using ABA; it can double the damage you put out.
Level Voidinator to 15 before wave 130 to 140 for more speed and damage from B traits.
Keep leveling towers to 20 and even 25 depending on points you can generate.
Kraken towers at level 20 are necessary for waves 160 plus.
Level 25 Krakens give much more security if possible.
Hold on to a decent amount of points for the tower swaps at wave 180.
Each Kraken to level 25 costs about 1.1 million points but three at level 25 equal four at level 20 in speed and eyeballs.
From level 20 plus always choose trait B on Poisonic Elder; at 25 traits are A B A B B B.
Spend points to level Stormcaller to 25 as soon as you can for 100% crit chance and consistent damage.
The build is basically complete until around wave 180 or 190 depending on your towers.
You can level Party Starters to 30 but he recommends saving points for later tower swaps.
Around waves 170 to 180 start using Beast Master Stop Right There talent because mobs can glitch through at the end of the first platform.
Put Stop Right There on the action bar with auto attack on so it is used consistently in later waves.
At the end of wave 190 swap Voidinator and first Kraken to one or two Poisonic Elders for more damage.
Change them back to Kraken and Voidinator before the start of wave 191.
Wave 200 is a four-phase fight; phase one uses the normal setup until all enemies are summoned and Voidinator removes their colors.
Phase two: replace Poisonic Elder and Voidinator with two more Krakens and level them as quickly as possible with the same traits.
Over 400 enemies are on the map so use Stop Right There as frequently as possible.
Once most small enemies die and mobs are under control switch back to towers that deal more damage.
Phase three starts at about 180 to 190 mobs left; sell one to two Krakens to add back Poisonic Elders but keep most points.
Phase four starts at 18 mobs left; sell all bottom row towers except two Krakens and the Frozone.
Summon on the platform above the totem: one Voidinator then three Poisonic Elders by the rope ladder then Frozone and two Krakens above and two Poisonics at top.
Rush to level up all those towers with the same traits as before.
Krakens are B then four A's; Frozone all A; Voidinators all B; Poisonics A B A B then B at level 25.
Delete your last two to three towers at the start and summon another Poisonic at the top along with a Stormcaller.
If you have points summon two more Poisonics behind your Kraken towers.
Most important is leveling Frozone and Kraken towers to contain the mobs; the rest can be slower.
Level all towers on the map to around 25 and wait until all mobs die to finish wave 200.
Let the mobs in wave 201 actually kill the totem; don't forfeit as it can make you lose progress.
If your towers are strong enough 200 may not be the limit.
